all.title: Women's Kurta Sets & Indian Wear
all.copy: Shop women’s kurta sets and Indian wear for everyday plans, the office and celebrations. Explore printed and embroidered designs, including styles with straight pants and dupattas. Check each product for the exact included pieces, fabric, garment measurements and available sizes.

casual-wear.title: Casual Kurta Sets for Women
casual-wear.copy: Explore casual kurta sets and Indian wear for everyday dressing. Browse printed and embroidered designs, then compare each style’s fabric, garment measurements, included pieces and available sizes. Check whether your chosen outfit includes pants, a dupatta or both.

work-wear.title: Office Wear Kurta Sets for Women
work-wear.copy: Build your working wardrobe with HIDI’s office wear kurta sets. Compare straight and coordinated silhouettes, floral designs and embroidery. Check the fabric, garment measurements, included pieces and available sizes on each product before choosing your work outfit.

occasional-wear.title: Occasion Wear Kurta & Anarkali Sets
occasional-wear.copy: Explore occasion wear kurta and Anarkali sets for celebrations and festive plans. Discover embroidered designs and outfits with dupattas, with the exact included pieces listed on each product. Compare fabric, garment measurements and available sizes before choosing your outfit.
